english.title: Commission of Further offence whilst subject to a suspended sentence
english.standardoffencewording:
Commission of a further offence committed during the operational period of a suspended sentence of **(..PERIOD OF IMPRISONMENT..) imprisonment suspended for **(..PERIOD OF SUSPENSION..) imposed on **(..DATE OF SUSPENDED SENTENCE..) at **(..NAME OF COURT..)

(A)_[for an offence of **(..ORIGINAL OFFENCE..)]_
(B)_[for the offences of **(..ORIGINAL OFFENCES..)]_
english.legislation: In accordance with section 119 of the Powers of Criminal Courts (Sentencing) Act 2000.

investigatoraction.description: Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: Document for use by the Magistrates Court staff

welsh.welshoffencetitle: Cyflawni trosedd arall tra'n destun dedfryd ohiriedig
welsh.welshstandardoffencewording:
Cyflawni trosedd arall yn ystod cyfnod gweithredol dedfryd ohiriedig o **(..PERIOD OF IMPRISONMENT..) o garchar wedi'i ohirio am **(..PERIOD OF SUSPENSION..) a roddwyd ar **(..DATE OF SUSPENDED SENTENCE..) yn **(..NAME OF COURT..)

(A)_[am y trosedd **(..ORIGINAL OFFENCE..)]_
(B)_[am y troseddau **(..ORIGINAL OFFENCES..)]_
welsh.welshlegislation: Yn unol ag adran 119 Deddf Pwerau Llysoedd Troseddol (Dedfrydu) 2000.
